beats.text: Your weird fantasy? Probably not that weird.
Researchers asked over fifteen hundred adults to rate dozens of sexual fantasies.
Very few turned out to be rare. Most were shared by lots of people.
Fantasies about power and control, taking it or giving it up, came up especially often.
As the lead researcher put it: there are a lot more common fantasies than unusual ones.
So that thought you'd never say out loud? You're in good company. And a fantasy is a thought, not a plan.

sources: Joyal, Cossette & Lapierre (2015). What exactly is an unusual sexual fantasy? Journal of Sexual Medicine 12(2). 1,517 Quebec adults; few fantasies statistically rare or unusual; submission themes reported by a significant proportion of women (30-60%); quote 'there are a lot more common fantasies than atypical fantasies'. Via Newswise/PsyPost.
